description: Report runtime versions: server name + version (from package.json), MCP protocol version, Node version, platform os/arch, the pinned bot container image tag, whether MOJULO_OFFLINE_BUILD is on, and the active MOJULO_HOME. Use this to diagnose version mismatches between a user-reported issue and what their control plane is actually running, or to confirm a version bump landed after a publish. Read-only, no inputs, idempotent.
name: version
